notes: Semantically, the difference between the sentences in (17) is that the passive sentence is a characterising statement evoking the general state of the earth. In contrast, the impersonal construction strongly requires some human agent to be conducting the action of feeding (i.e. sowing.) In conjunction with this, passivised verbs show agreement with the promoted theme, but impersonal verbs can only take default 3SG agreement. Thus, accusative retention and any non-3SG morphology on the verb are in complementary distribution.
